answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. Picture a plume field, a ivory in flight, a trellis in the distance — a natural triad mirroring how layered signals resist a single-point forgery.
